'''Darth Arrid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="Codex" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who served on the [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Reproduction/Legends|child]] of Dark Councilor [[Darth Vax]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was relatively young when he succeeded his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] on the Council after her [[Death/Legends|death]], assuming the title of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Arrid in the process. However, his mother persisted as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] and manipulated her son behind the scenes, turning him into a mouthpiece for her will, and it took the rest of the Council four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to realize that Arrid was simply Vax's puppet.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Arrid was first mentioned in the "Force Ghost" Codex entry in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], the [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
